# Grow with RP

> Grow with RP is a digital marketing and web development company in India. It offers SEO, AI SEO (AEO and GEO), WordPress and Shopify development, website changes and maintenance, social media marketing, AI video creation, Google Ads and Meta Ads management. The company is based in Kaithal, Haryana, and works with clients across India and worldwide.

## Services

- [SEO Services](https://www.growwithrp.tech/seo-services.html): technical SEO, on-page SEO, keyword research, local SEO, Google Business Profile and ethical link building.
- [AI SEO (AEO and GEO)](https://www.growwithrp.tech/ai-seo-services.html): clear answers, consistent business information and readiness for Google AI Overviews and AI assistants, built on SEO fundamentals.
- [WordPress Development](https://www.growwithrp.tech/wordpress-website-development.html): fast, mobile-first business websites, redesigns and maintenance.
- [Shopify Development](https://www.growwithrp.tech/shopify-store-development.html): Shopify store setup, product pages, payments, shipping, SEO basics and migrations.
- [Web Development](https://www.growwithrp.tech/web-development-services.html): responsive business websites and landing pages.
- [AI Video Services](https://www.growwithrp.tech/ai-video-services.html): AI video generation, editing, promotional videos and social media videos, reviewed by a person before publishing.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://www.growwithrp.tech/social-media-marketing.html): content calendars, creatives, captions and organic audience growth.
- [Google Ads Management](https://www.growwithrp.tech/google-ads-management.html): search campaign setup, weekly checks, conversion tracking and monthly reports.
- [Meta Ads Management](https://www.growwithrp.tech/meta-ads-management.html): Facebook and Instagram campaigns. The management fee is separate from ad spend.
